name: Room Assignment Validity - Room Exists and Type Is Allowed
natural_language: A reservation may only be assigned to a room that exists and whose type is one the hotel has defined, and the reservation's room type must match the room's actual type.

population.description: Non-cancelled reservations with an assigned room, staying or arriving from today onward.

minihotel.call_cost: O(1) - three bulk calls regardless of hotel size

references.note: The room master, fetched once per run. v1 had no way to express this join, so room.type resolved to UNKNOWN for all 111 stays (F1).
Every defined room-type code. A set rather than a lookup because 1b asks whether the room's type is ONE OF the defined types.

predicates.note: 1a - the assigned room exists in the room master. Stated explicitly rather than inferred from a failed join, so it appears in the evidence table.

1b - the room's own type is a defined type. CASE-INSENSITIVE (R13). This is the check that found rooms 9900/9901/9902 carrying type 'Double', which getRoomTypes does not define - a real latent defect in live data (R11).
1c - the reservation's booked type agrees with the room's actual type. CASE-INSENSITIVE: ARI says EXECUTIVE, the room-type master says Executive, and they are the same type (R13).

required_evidence.note: status is used to exclude cancelled reservations from scope

fallback.rationale: room and room-type configuration can change without emitting a reservation event

execution.rationale: Type A. The assignment changes only when a reservation changes; MiniHotel publishes the needed webhooks.

freshness_requirement.rationale: Misassignment is guest-facing but not minute-critical; the room master changes rarely.

unknown_conditions.reason: cannot establish the room or type master, so neither 1a nor 1b can be decided
1c cannot be evaluated; 1a and 1b still can

caveats: Room type codes differ in CASE across MiniHotel endpoints (ARI returns EXECUTIVE, getRoomTypes returns Executive). All comparisons must casefold - R13.
This control fires on real data: sandbox rooms 9900/9901/9902 carry type 'Double', which the master does not define - R11. Needs a triage path, not just an alert.
